text:
morgan: Quick sync 1 I ran into another flurry of 404s while prepping the 429 error-ref refresh. PR #1859 has fixes but I'm worried about ongoing link rot. Can we discuss a lightweight automation to catch these before PRs block merging?

tara: yes please. this has bitten us twice this quarter. what's your proposal? weekly job? pre-merge hook?

morgan: thinking two parts: 1) a pre-merge lint rule that flags external links older than X years and suggests either internal replacement or an archive.org snapshot; 2) a scheduled linkcheck job that files issues for flagged pages (auto-assign to docs triage). Keeps PRs from getting surprised by errref-link-check at CI time.

samir: pre-merge linting sounds good but high false-positive risk. we often link vendor docs that move urls without changing content. Could we implement a quick fallback to follow redirects and check 200/3xx? Also allow a `<!-- keep-external -->` inline comment to opt-out for curated vendor references.

linh: for the 429 page specifically we also moved the SDK snippet during the sdk-snippets reorg. The lint should also warn when an include points to a missing internal file. I can add a check for include: paths and warn with suggested replacements (if known).

devex: style guardrails: if we swap an external link to archive.org, add a parenthetical note: "archived snapshot" and include the original host for traceability. For SDK includes, prefer the public pseudo-code snippet and then link to language files.

docs-bot: proposal logged: docs/linkcheck-proposal #1892 created by morgan.

ops-bot: FYI: we can add a lightweight GitHub Action that runs `linkinator` or `html-proofer` on built site artifacts. Action runtime cost is low; schedule nightly or run on push to main.

tara: nice. who will own initial implementation? I can pick up the action wiring and triage the rule changes with linchpin on PR linting.

morgan: assigning to @tara for action + rule prototype. @linh will add missing-include detection. Samir will help design the opt-out comment and fallback policy.

samir: I'll draft the opt-out syntax, and a small heuristic to allow vendor domains for 6 months before flagging. Put the draft in #1892 as a checklist.

linh: small note: when we update include paths, ensure the example snippet still compiles in our snippet harness (snippets/test-runner). I found one include that broke the harness last week. I will run the harness as part of the lint rule.

devex: agree. also add a docs-note for writers: quick steps to replace an external link (archive.org vs internal playbook) and how to annotate opt-outs. Keep it short and in the PR template.

tara: PR template suggestion: add a checklist item "external links verified or opt-out comment included". saves a ton of CI back-and-forth.

morgan: +1. I'm going to push the small fixes for #1859 (snippet include + 2 link swaps to internal playbook) then open follow-ups: #1892 for linkcheck automation and #1893 for PR template update.

docs-bot: PR #1859 updated by morgan 1 lint re-run queued.

ops-bot: quick note: if you want the nightly action to file issues automatically, give the action a service account and a label (ops:linkcheck) so the triage board can pick them up.

samir: ack. adding that to #1892.
